plans.asset: From Energy Signals to Constrained Claims
plans.destination: Externally tested integrated framework with a peer-reviewed verdict, followed by a non-overlapping proceedings or journal pathway.
plans.decisive_blocker: The synthesis must fit an 8-page anonymized FC'27 short paper by making financial rights, settlement, enforceable constraints, and failure modes central without consuming the standalone ECI and CL contributions.

routes.success_branch: ACCEPTED -> proceedings revision -> acceptance-stage registration/travel gate -> capture reviewer feedback -> next publication decision
routes.failure_branch: REJECTED_WITH_USEFUL_REVIEWS -> preserve reviews -> revise synthesis -> journal-first or later specialist route
routes.abort_branch: FIT_REQUIRES_DISTORTION -> do not submit -> build journal-first synthesis

stop_rules: Do not use Policy Lab runtime behavior as proof that the academic boundaries are empirically validated.
Do not publish the full ECI empirical contribution inside the synthesis merely to strengthen FC fit.
Do not publish the full CL institutional taxonomy inside the synthesis merely to strengthen FC fit.
Do not force a generic energy-and-money paper into a financial-cryptography venue.

plans.asset: When Does Energy Track the Real Economy?
plans.destination: Reproducible standalone measurement/admissibility paper with explicit temporal-stability and structural-break boundaries.
plans.decisive_blocker: The paper must demonstrate when an energy-adjacent observable remains economically informative rather than assuming a stable energy/economy relationship.
plans.success_branch: EMPIRICAL_GATE_PASS -> targeted specialist route census -> specialist validation -> publication decision
plans.failure_branch: RELATIONSHIP_UNSTABLE_OR_WEAK -> narrow admissibility claim, retain negative boundary result, or merge only the valid evidence into the research program
stop_rules: Do not treat GRASFI 2027 as live; its 2026-08-31 submission deadline has passed.
Do not reuse the FC'27 synthesis as the ECI paper.
Do not promote a sample-specific coefficient into a timeless production oracle.

plans.asset: The Constrained Ledger: When Does Energy Actually Discipline Digital Money?
plans.destination: Distinct institutional-constraint paper with independent propositions about issuance, pricing, settlement, and governance.
plans.decisive_blocker: CL must contain a standalone institutional contribution rather than becoming the architecture sections of CL-ECI under a new title.
stop_rules: Do not create a second manuscript by deleting ECI sections from the synthesis.
Do not claim physical backing is binding unless issuance or settlement-relevant rights are actually constrained.

plans.destination: Externally tested comparative digital-tax paper, strengthened by funded extension and specialist feedback, followed by one deliberate journal submission.
plans.decisive_blocker: Preserve transaction-path comparison, activation specificity, transaction-control constraint, and Stage A versus Stage B capacity while adapting outward packets.

plans.terminal_publication_rule: After useful external feedback or once conferences stop adding information, choose one journal family and activate only one overlapping journal review.
stop_rules: Do not turn DT into a generic five-country descriptive survey.
Do not add causal identification claims the design does not support.
Do not accept expensive travel merely because an abstract is accepted.

portfolio_kill_rules: No calendar deadline may promote a research-build asset to conversion-ready.
No radar result may activate without assignment to a plan purpose and predecessor gate.
No duplicate CL, ECI, and CL-ECI peer-reviewed manuscript may be created by retitling overlapping contribution.
No internal audit, repository polish, DOI, archive, or runtime demonstration may be described as external scholarly validation.
No conference acceptance may be described as journal publication.
No expensive travel is authorized automatically by acceptance.
No paper may be weakened into a venue-native but scientifically inferior framing merely to increase submission count.
